calls.name: Ada Moss
calls.message: Connect me with Mabel Dunmore, please.

calls.name: Arthur Hollis
calls.message: Good morning! Irene Godfrey, if you would.

calls.name: Lillian Yardley
calls.message: Put me through to Reginald Underhill, dear.

calls.name: Bernard Quigley
calls.message: Mildred Stanhope, please. It's about the church fete.

calls.name: Gertrude Rook
calls.message: Ada Moss, please. I need my dress hemmed by Sunday.

calls.name: Reginald Underhill
calls.message: Get me Arthur Hollis. Quickly now, I'm a busy man.

calls.name: Mabel Dunmore
calls.message: Could you ring Bernard Quigley for me?

calls.name: Mildred Stanhope
calls.message: Gertrude Rook, please. Tea is at four!

calls.name: Doris Cobbold
calls.message: Edgar Pennington, please. He owes me a shilling.

calls.name: Walter Pryce
calls.message: Rose Ellery, please. I have the tickets for Saturday.

calls.name: Herbert Marlow
calls.message: Get me the Doctor! My wife has taken a fall!

calls.name: Eleanor Vickery
calls.message: Lillian Yardley, please. It's her sister.

calls.name: Ada Moss
calls.message: Walter Pryce, the tailor, if you please.

calls.name: Edgar Pennington
calls.message: Herbert Marlow. Tell him it's about the cricket.

calls.name: Rose Ellery
calls.message: Doris Cobbold, please. Is the bakery open?

calls.name: Arthur Hollis
calls.message: My neighbour is ill, get me the Doctor!

calls.name: Irene Godfrey
calls.message: Eleanor Vickery, please. I've news from London.

calls.name: Reginald Underhill
calls.message: Rose Ellery. And be quick about it.

calls.name: Basil Thorne
calls.message: Clara Whitlock, please. About the piano lessons.

calls.name: Stanley Burrows
calls.message: Norman Tulley, if he's in.

calls.name: Violet Ingram
calls.message: Fire! Get me the Fire Brigade, quick!

calls.name: Cecil Jessop
calls.message: Gladys Ormsby. I've a parcel for her.

calls.name: Harold Lacey
calls.message: Basil Thorne, please. It's his brother Harold.

calls.name: Gladys Ormsby
calls.message: Stanley Burrows, the grocer, please.

calls.name: Norman Tulley
calls.message: The baby has a fever! The Doctor, please!

calls.name: Clara Whitlock
calls.message: Cecil Jessop. He'll know what it's about.

calls.name: Doris Cobbold
calls.message: Violet Ingram, please. Is the choir on tonight?

calls.name: Edgar Pennington
calls.message: Harold Lacey. Tell him the car is ready.

calls.name: Mabel Dunmore
calls.message: The barn is burning! Fire Brigade, quick!

calls.name: Ada Moss
calls.message: Clara Whitlock, please. She left her gloves here.

calls.name: Leonard Norcross
calls.message: Ivy Crandall, please. I've found her cat.

calls.name: Sidney Hargreaves
calls.message: Percy Fairweather. It's about the horse races.

calls.name: Martha Gilchrist
calls.message: A burglar! Get me the Police, quick!

calls.name: Winifred Ridley
calls.message: Otis Bramble, please. The fence needs mending.

calls.name: Louisa Kemble
calls.message: Albert Zouch. I've his spectacles.

calls.name: Florence Abbott
calls.message: Leonard Norcross, please. Dinner is at seven.

calls.name: Otis Bramble
calls.message: The chimney's on fire! Fire Brigade!

calls.name: Ivy Crandall
calls.message: Sidney Hargreaves, if you please.

calls.name: Percy Fairweather
calls.message: Martha Gilchrist. Tell her I'll be late.

calls.name: Albert Zouch
calls.message: He's fainted! Get me the Doctor!

calls.name: Harold Lacey
calls.message: Florence Abbott, please. About the bazaar.

calls.name: Stanley Burrows
calls.message: My shop's been robbed! The Police, please!

calls.name: Arthur Hollis
calls.message: Louisa Kemble. I've a letter for her.

calls.name: Gertrude Rook
calls.message: Winifred Ridley, please. Bring the jam!
